notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control seven or more creatures.
description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, causing Evendo, Waking Haven to become a creature and untapping it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
